title: AWS Regions and how to choose one

kcs.statement: An AWS Region is a separate geographic area made up of multiple isolated Availability Zones, and most AWS resources are created in and scoped to one Region.

The four factors for choosing a Region are compliance and data-residency rules, proximity to users (latency), which services and features are available there, and price, which differs between Regions.
Data stored in a Region stays in that Region unless the customer explicitly copies or moves it elsewhere, so picking a Region inside a country is how data-residency laws are met.
